You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Thomas Snyder
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0124 | thomas.snyder@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Ecommerce operations specialist at an online furniture retailer, handling order, fulfillment and returns reporting for a business that ships about 9,000 orders a month. Works mostly in Excel and Shopify reports, writes some SQL against the order database, and learned Power BI independently to replace a set of manual spreadsheets. Looking for a dedicated analyst role with more time on data and less on daily order exceptions.

EXPERIENCE
Ecommerce Operations Specialist | Loftwood Home Online, Columbus, OH | Feb 2021 to Present
• Prepare the weekly operations report on orders, ship times, damage claims and returns for the director of operations, pulling from Shopify, the 3PL portal and Gorgias customer service data.
• Built a returns reason analysis showing that 38% of sofa returns cited color mismatch. Merchandising reshot product photos for 120 fabric options, and returns on those items fell from 14% to 9%.
• Picked up Power BI through online modules and built an order fulfillment dashboard that replaced four Excel workbooks; the operations and customer service leads now open it daily.
• Write basic SQL queries (joins across orders, line items and shipments) on a read-only Postgres replica set up by the engineering team, mostly for carrier delay and backorder questions.
• Reconcile monthly freight invoices from two LTL carriers against shipment records, recovering about $26,000 in billing errors in 2025.
• Work with the warehouse partner to resolve stock discrepancies between Shopify and the 3PL inventory feed, keeping a running Excel log of SKUs that drift out of sync and why.
• Track average days from order to delivery by carrier and region in a monthly summary; the 2024 numbers supported moving large item deliveries from one white glove carrier to another, cutting average delivery time from 16 to 11 days.
• Built Excel templates for the customer service team to log damage photos and claim amounts, which shortened the claims filing process with carriers.
• Answer quick data requests from the marketing and merchandising teams, such as top returned SKUs or backorder counts by collection, usually within a day.

Customer Order Coordinator | Bramblewood Interiors, Columbus, OH | Jul 2018 to Jan 2021
• Managed special orders and delivery scheduling for a two showroom furniture retailer, usually about 150 open orders at a time.
• Kept an Excel tracker of vendor ship dates and delays that the sales staff used to update customers.
• Built a simple weekly report of delivered, delayed and cancelled orders for the owner.
• Processed damage claims with freight carriers and vendors, recovering credits on about 60 claims a year.
• Updated product availability and lead times on the showroom website each week from vendor emails.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2018

SKILLS
Reporting: Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query), Power BI (report building, basic DAX), Shopify Analytics, Google Sheets
Data: SQL (basic to intermediate, PostgreSQL), CSV exports from 3PL and carrier portals
Ecommerce operations: order management, returns processing, freight claims, inventory sync

ADDITIONAL
• Completed the Mode SQL tutorial and Microsoft Learn Power BI modules, 2023
• Volunteer at a Columbus community tool library, keeping the lending inventory spreadsheet up to date
